research.claim: The analyst expected electronics revenue to grow more than 40% in FY27.
Q4 FY26 revenue was INR 41.5bn and EBITDA INR 3.6bn at an 8.4% margin; reported PAT was INR 1.34bn.
Management guidance described RAC growth outperformance of 13-15%.
Period-end working-capital days increased from 9 to 56; the analyst also presented an adjusted 29-day figure.
Net debt was described as approximately INR 19bn.
The analyst estimated EPC revenue and EBITDA CAGR of approximately 20% and 22% over FY26-FY28E.
The report also states FY27 MDO revenue of approximately INR 16.9bn versus INR 16.1bn in FY25.
Management guided standalone FY27 revenue growth of 30-40%, margin expansion of 150-200bps, and INR 100-120bn order inflow.
Q4 FY26 revenue was INR 18.602bn, EBITDA INR 1.995bn, and EBITDA margin 10.7%.
Standalone net debt was described as approximately INR 18.8bn.
Mining revenue could rise from approximately INR 16bn in FY26 to INR 25bn, INR 31bn, and INR 40bn in FY27-FY29E.
FY26 company-incurred capex was described as approximately INR 4.7bn.
The model shows FY26E EBITDA of INR 7.932bn and FY27E/FY28E EBITDA of INR 14.287bn/17.393bn.
Q4 FY26 revenue was approximately INR 24.4bn, EBITDA INR 2.5bn at a 10.2% margin, and adjusted PAT approximately INR 1bn.
FY26 reported EBITDA was INR 7.882bn and reported PAT INR 2.044bn.
Management guided double-digit revenue growth, EBITDA margin recovery into the teens, zero net debt by end-FY27, and FY27 capex of INR 4-5bn.
The analyst model shows FY26E capex of INR 7.105bn.
The analyst forecast FY27E/FY28E sales of INR 84bn/88bn and net profit of INR 5.9bn/6.9bn.
